lklynet/spider-solitaire

commit d4478182a93da6b02ab9f590bb2f7409461077a4

Spider: eight 13-card same-suit runs, ten tableau piles, a stock that
deals one card onto each pile only when no pile is empty. 1/2/4-suit
deals match Microsoft Spider (eight, four, or two copies of each rank
per suit). Upstream is React + Zustand + Vite with themes and a hint
engine. This port destacks the engine (deck, moves, replay) to classic
scripts. The tableau is a private save. Tap a run, tap where it goes;
drag works too.
